commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
For a ruler who can give with sweet words and protect, this world joins with his renown and is all he intends: it yields everything he wishes. Giving means giving people what they need, and protecting means keeping them from harm by his retinue and his enemies. These are hard, so it says “can”. He will rule the whole earth.

சொல் can mean his word or, as he takes it, his renown.
